Deliciously Unassuming
Jun 2025 • Couples
This little cafe / resto is a diamond in the rough. 

Just a few blocks from our hotel we decided to stop one night after a long day of sight-seeing. So glad we did!

The place was mostly empty except for a few locals. Up to this point we had tried a few other places and street food but were not really satisfied with the local cuisine.

So thankful we stopped at My Pho! 

The food was some of the best Vietnamese on a budget we experienced in our time there. Very tasty and authentic and super good prices.

We travelled with friends and both agreed it was great. We even went back a second time to try more dishes! The second night we "customised" the meal and the owner was very attentive and careful to prepare exactly what we requested. 

Overall a very enjoyable and memorable experience!

My Pho - Local food gem of Hanoi
Sep 2024 • Couples
What an amazing find in Hanoi. The food was super affordable and tasted great. My husband refused to have dinner anywhere else. The only thing that topped.the food was the staff. Super efficient service and super friendly. Despite the language barrier you are felt so welcome. Google translate worked really great. "Uncle" and "Aunty" as adopted by my husband did the front service and were constantly smiling and happy. The kids did the cooking and damn can those 3 young adults cook. They turned out dishes so fast. Average waiting time no more than 5 minutes. The menu is all Vietnamese and has a really nice variety. The pho ga and ba was my favorite and I swear with each bite my taste senses went into over drive. Condiments of raw chilli, chilli paste and lemons were in abundance. The sticky mango rice dessert was amazing, not over sweet. Recommended beer is Saigon or Halib (excuse my misspelling if I got it wrong) but they have non-alcoholic beverages as well. In my opinion, this little magical food gem is worthy of 5 stars and must visit when in Hanoi.
